title: 解释什么是Downward API
answer:
```python
def read(api,path):
    code,obj=api('GET',path);assert code==200,obj
    return obj

def command(run,args):
    code,out,err=run(args);assert code==0,(code,out,err)
    return out

import time

def solve(api,run,case):
    before=command(run,['exec',case['name'],'-c','main','--','sh','-c','printf %s "$SNAPSHOT"'])
    code,obj=api('PATCH',case['path'],{'metadata':{'labels':{'probe':case['new_label']}}},'application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200,obj
    for _ in range(140):
        value=command(run,['exec',case['name'],'-c','main','--','cat','/meta/probe'])
        if value==case['new_label']:break
        time.sleep(.25)
    else:raise AssertionError('projected Downward API volume did not expose new label')
    after=command(run,['exec',case['name'],'-c','main','--','sh','-c','printf %s "$SNAPSHOT"'])
    return {'env_before':before,'env_after':after,'volume_after':value}
```

原题原理与边界
Downward API 将 Pod/容器的部分元数据或资源信息通过环境变量、文件暴露给容器，避免应用必须直接访问 API。可用字段和更新行为取决于方式；环境变量一般在容器创建时确定，不能假设随标签修改自动刷新。

def container(s,name,script='sleep 3600',**extra):
    return {'name':name,'image':s.image,'imagePullPolicy':'Never','command':['sh','-c',script],
            'resources':{'requests':{'cpu':'5m','memory':'4Mi'},'limits':{'cpu':'50m','memory':'32Mi'}},**extra}


def exec_text(s,name,command,which='main'):
    code,out,err=s.run(['exec',name,'-c',which,'--','sh','-c',command])
    assert code==0,(code,out,err)
    return out


def readonly_trace(s,verbs=('get',)):
    for item in s.trace:
        if 'method' in item:assert item['method']=='GET','Read-only question must not modify API objects'
        else:assert item.get('args',[None])[0] in verbs,'Read-only question must not use a kubectl write command'


def check_downward():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        first,second=token('old'),token('new');keep=token('keep')
        main=container(s,'main',env=[{'name':'SNAPSHOT','valueFrom':{'fieldRef':{'fieldPath':"metadata.labels['probe']"}}}],
                       volumeMounts=[{'name':'meta','mountPath':'/meta','readOnly':True}])
        obj=s.pod({'containers':[main],'volumes':[{'name':'meta','downwardAPI':{'items':[{'path':'probe','fieldRef':{'fieldPath':"metadata.labels['probe']"}}]}}]},labels={'probe':first,'preserve':keep})
        name=obj['metadata']['name'];obj=s.ready_pod(name)
        assert exec_text(s,name,'printf %s "$SNAPSHOT"')==first
        assert exec_text(s,name,'cat /meta/probe')==first
        s.trace=[]
        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'path':s.path('pods',name),'name':name,'new_label':second})
        assert result=={'env_before':first,'env_after':first,'volume_after':second}
        current=s.get(s.path('pods',name))
        assert current['metadata']['uid']==obj['metadata']['uid'] and current['spec']==obj['spec']
        assert current['metadata']['labels']=={'probe':second,'preserve':keep}
        assert exec_text(s,name,'printf %s "$SNAPSHOT"')==first and exec_text(s,name,'cat /meta/probe')==second
        assert any(t.get('method')=='PATCH' for t in s.trace),'must really update label'

        p=s.pod();name=p['metadata']['name'];live=s.ready_pod(name);s.trace=[]
        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'path':s.path('pods',name),'container':'main'})
        state=live['status']['containerStatuses'][0]
        assert state['state'].get('running') and state['imageID']
        assert result=={'declared':p['spec']['containers'][0]['image'],'actual':state['imageID'],'pod_uid':p['metadata']['uid']}
        assert result['actual']!=result['declared'],'runtime identity must not be copied from declared image'

def check_counts():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        for extra in (0,1):

            name=p['metadata']['name']

        assert result=={'node':ready['spec']['nodeName'],'pod_ip':ready['status']['podIP'],'host_ip':ready['status']['hostIP'],'pending_node':None,'pending_reason':'Unschedulable'}
        assert result['node'] in {n['metadata']['name'] for n in s.nodes}
        readonly_trace(s)

def check_logs():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        previous,current,other=token('previous'),token('current'),token('other')
        script=f'if test -f /history/started; then echo {current}; sleep 3600; else echo {previous}; touch /history/started; exit 17; fi'
        p=s.pod({'containers':[container(s,'worker',script,volumeMounts=[{'name':'history','mountPath':'/history'}]),container(s,'observer',f'echo {other}; sleep 3600')],
                 'volumes':[{'name':'history','emptyDir':{}}]})
        name=p['metadata']['name']
        def restarted():
            live=s.get(s.path('pods',name));state=next((x for x in live.get('status',{}).get('containerStatuses',[]) if x['name']=='worker'),{})
            return live if state.get('restartCount',0)>=1 and 'running' in state.get('state',{}) else False
        s.wait(restarted,30,'real worker restart with retained previous logs');s.trace=[]
        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'name':name,'uid':p['metadata']['uid'],'worker':'worker','other':'observer'})
        assert result=={'previous':previous,'current':current,'other':other,'pod_uid':p['metadata']['uid']}
        assert any('--previous' in t.get('args',[]) for t in s.trace)
        assert all(t.get('args',[None])[0]=='logs' for t in s.trace)


def check_mounts():

        payload=token('shared');writer=container(s,'mounted',f'echo {payload} > /shared/value; sleep 3600',volumeMounts=[{'name':'shared','mountPath':'/shared'}])
        p=s.pod({'containers':[writer,container(s,'unmounted')],'volumes':[{'name':'shared','emptyDir':{}}]})
        name=p['metadata']['name'];p=s.ready_pod(name);s.trace=[]
        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'name':name,'mounted':'mounted','unmounted':'unmounted','path':'/shared/value'})
        assert result=={'mounted_value':payload,'unmounted_exists':False}
        assert result['unmounted_exists'] is False
        assert any(t.get('args',[None])[0]=='exec' and 'mounted' in t['args'] for t in s.trace)
        assert any(t.get('args',[None])[0]=='exec' and 'unmounted' in t['args'] for t in s.trace)
        assert s.get(s.path('pods',name))['spec']==p['spec']

def check_samepod():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        nonce=token('loopback');port=20000+int(token().split('-')[1][:4],16)%20000
        server=container(s,'server',f'mkdir -p /web; printf %s {nonce} > /web/index.html; httpd -f -p {port} -h /web')
        p=s.pod({'containers':[server,container(s,'client')]});name=p['metadata']['name'];ready=s.ready_pod(name)
        other=s.pod();other_name=other['metadata']['name'];s.ready_pod(other_name)
        def responding():
            code,out,err=s.run(['exec',name,'-c','client','--','wget','-T','2','-qO-',f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/'])
            return out if code==0 and out==nonce else False

def check_phase():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        p=s.pod({'containers':[container(s,'main','exit 23')]});name=p['metadata']['name']
        def backoff():
            live=s.get(s.path('pods',name));states=live.get('status',{}).get('containerStatuses',[])
            return live if states and states[0].get('state',{}).get('waiting',{}).get('reason')=='CrashLoopBackOff' else False
        live=s.wait(backoff,30,'actual kubelet CrashLoopBackOff');s.trace=[]
        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'name':name,'path':s.path('pods',name)})
        assert result=={'phase':live['status']['phase'],'container_state':'waiting','reason':'CrashLoopBackOff','table_status':'CrashLoopBackOff'}
        assert result['phase']=='Running' and result['phase']!=result['table_status']
        assert any(t.get('args',[None])[0]=='get' for t in s.trace)
        readonly_trace(s)


def deploy(s,replicas=1,**pod_spec):
    name=token('deployment');label=token('app')
    spec={'automountServiceAccountToken':False,'terminationGracePeriodSeconds':0,'nodeSelector':{'hw':'compute'},'containers':[container(s,'main')]}
    spec.update(pod_spec)
    spec['nodeSelector']={'hw':'compute',**pod_spec.get('nodeSelector',{})}
    return s.create('deployments',{'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'Deployment','metadata':{'name':name},
        'spec':{'replicas':replicas,'selector':{'matchLabels':{'app':label}},'strategy':{'type':'RollingUpdate','rollingUpdate':{'maxSurge':1,'maxUnavailable':0}},
                'template':{'metadata':{'labels':{'app':label}},'spec':spec}}},'/apis/apps/v1')


def ready_deployment(s,obj,seconds=35):
    path=s.path('deployments',obj['metadata']['name'],'/apis/apps/v1')
    def ready():
        live=s.get(path);status=live.get('status',{});desired=live['spec']['replicas']
        return live if status.get('observedGeneration',0)>=live['metadata']['generation'] and status.get('updatedReplicas',0)==desired and status.get('availableReplicas',0)==desired and status.get('replicas',0)==desired else False
    return s.wait(ready,seconds,'actual Deployment Available and updated replicas')


def check_rollback():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        nonce=token('original');dep=deploy(s,containers=[container(s,'main',f'echo {nonce}; sleep 3600',env=[{'name':'PRESERVE','value':nonce}])])
        first=ready_deployment(s,dep);path=s.path('deployments',dep['metadata']['name'],'/apis/apps/v1')
        original_template=copy.deepcopy(first['spec']['template'])
        failed=copy.deepcopy(first);failed['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['command']=['sh','-c','exit 29']
        code,failed=s.request('PUT',path,failed);assert code==200,(code,failed)
        selector=first['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']['app']
        def failed_instance():
            pods=s.get(s.path('pods')+'?labelSelector=app%3D'+selector)['items']
            return [p for p in pods if any(x.get('restartCount',0)>=1 for x in p.get('status',{}).get('containerStatuses',[]))]
        s.wait(failed_instance,30,'actual failed rollout container restart');s.trace=[]
        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'name':dep['metadata']['name'],'path':path})
        assert any(t.get('args',[])[:2]==['rollout','undo'] for t in s.trace),'must really request native Deployment rollback'
        restored=ready_deployment(s,dep,30)
        assert result is True and restored['spec']['template']==original_template
        assert restored['metadata']['uid']==first['metadata']['uid'] and restored['spec']['replicas']==1
        assert int(restored['metadata']['annotations']['deployment.kubernetes.io/revision'])>int(first['metadata']['annotations']['deployment.kubernetes.io/revision'])
        sets=s.get(s.path('replicasets',group='/apis/apps/v1'))['items']
        failed_sets=[r for r in sets if r['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['command']==['sh','-c','exit 29']]
        assert failed_sets and all(r['spec']['replicas']==0 for r in failed_sets)


def check_diagnostics():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        nonce=token('application');healthy=s.pod({'containers':[container(s,'main',f'echo {nonce}; sleep 3600')]});name=healthy['metadata']['name'];s.ready_pod(name)
        blocked=s.pod({'nodeSelector':{'opsforge.invalid/'+token('label'):token('none')}});blocked_name=blocked['metadata']['name']

        s.wait(event_exists,20,'actual FailedScheduling event for same UID');s.trace=[]
        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'running_name':name,'running_uid':healthy['metadata']['uid'],'pending_name':blocked_name,'pending_uid':blocked['metadata']['uid']})
        assert result=={'application_log':nonce,'pending_reason':'FailedScheduling','running_uid':healthy['metadata']['uid'],'pending_uid':blocked['metadata']['uid']}
        assert any(t.get('args',[None])[0]=='describe' and blocked_name in t['args'] for t in s.trace)
        assert any(t.get('args',[None])[0]=='logs' and name in t['args'] for t in s.trace)

def check_resources():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        memory=32+int(token().split('-')[1][:2],16)%4*8
        milli=75+int(token().split('-')[1][:2],16)%4*25

        assert s.get(s.path('pods',name))['spec']['containers'][0]['resources']==resources

def check_selector():
    with NodeSession() as s:
        assert any(n['metadata'].get('labels',{}).get('hw')=='compute' for n in s.nodes),'Private workspace node must be launched with hw=compute; never relabel a shared node'
        bad_key='opsforge.invalid/'+token('key');keep=token('keep')

        path=s.path('deployments',dep['metadata']['name'],'/apis/apps/v1')

        s.wait(unscheduled,20,'actual unschedulable Deployment workload');s.trace=[]

        assert ready['spec']['template']['spec']['nodeSelector']=={'hw':'compute'}
        assert ready['spec']['template']['spec']['containers']==dep['spec']['template']['spec']['containers']

        labels=dep['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']['app']

title: 如何区分 Pod 声明的容器数量、已启动数量和就绪数量？
answer:
```python
def read(api,path):
    code,obj=api('GET',path);assert code==200,obj
    return obj

def command(run,args):
    code,out,err=run(args);assert code==0,(code,out,err)
    return out

def solve(api,run,case):
    pod=read(api,case['path']);spec=pod['spec'];status=pod['status']
    declared=sum(len(spec.get(k,[])) for k in ('containers','initContainers','ephemeralContainers'))
    running=sum('running' in c.get('state',{}) for k in ('containerStatuses','initContainerStatuses','ephemeralContainerStatuses') for c in status.get(k,[]))
    rows=command(run,['get','pod',case['name']]).splitlines()
    return {'declared':declared,'running':running,'table_ready':rows[1].split()[1],'business_healthy_proven':False}
```

原题原理与边界
先按字段分类，不把几种数量混成一个数：spec.containers 是普通容器；spec.initContainers 同时可能包含一次性 init 和 restartPolicy: Always 的原生 sidecar；spec.ephemeralContainers 是临时容器。对应状态分别在 status.containerStatuses、status.initContainerStatuses、status.ephemeralContainerStatuses，逐个检查 state.running/terminated/waiting、ready、started 及 restartCount。

本例共声明四个容器条目，其中普通业务容器一个；当前运行的是普通容器、原生 sidecar、临时调试容器，共三个，已完成的普通 init 不算正在运行。Kubernetes 1.34 的 Pod 表格打印会把可重启 init sidecar 纳入 READY 分母，已 started 且 ready 的该 sidecar 也计入分子。因此此例 READY 为 2/2，而不是只数 spec.containers 得出的 1/1；临时调试容器不纳入该就绪汇总。

用 kubectl get pod demo -n lab -o json 保留完整 spec/status，再对照 kubectl get pod demo -n lab 和 Pod conditions。READY 不是 HTTP 业务可用性的证明，也不是所有历史生命周期步骤的数量。旧版本或未使用原生 sidecar 的 Pod 不应机械套用本例；应核对所用 API Server/客户端打印版本。

```python
def read(api,path):
    code,obj=api('GET',path);assert code==200,obj
    return obj

def command(run,args):
    code,out,err=run(args);assert code==0,(code,out,err)
    return out

def solve(api,run,case):
    import time
    deadline=time.monotonic()+20
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        pod=read(api,case['path']);state=pod['status']['containerStatuses'][0]['state']
        rows=command(run,['get','pod',case['name']]).splitlines()
        table=rows[1].split()[2]
        if state.get('waiting',{}).get('reason')=='CrashLoopBackOff' and table=='CrashLoopBackOff':
            return {'phase':pod['status']['phase'],'container_state':'waiting','reason':state['waiting']['reason'],'table_status':table}
        time.sleep(.2)
    raise AssertionError('No matching native API and kubectl CrashLoopBackOff observations')
```

原题原理与边界
Pod phase 常见 Pending、Running、Succeeded、Failed、Unknown，概括生命周期；容器 state 是 waiting/running/terminated 并带原因；kubectl STATUS 列是面向用户的综合展示，可能显示 CrashLoopBackOff 或 Terminating。排障应读取原始 status、conditions 和事件，不能把所有 STATUS 字符串当作 phase 枚举。

def container(s,name,script='sleep 3600',**extra):

def readonly_trace(s,verbs=('get',)):

        name=obj['metadata']['name'];obj=s.ready_pod(name)

        assert exec_text(s,name,'cat /meta/probe')==first

        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'path':s.path('pods',name),'name':name,'new_label':second})
        assert result=={'env_before':first,'env_after':first,'volume_after':second}
        current=s.get(s.path('pods',name))
        assert current['metadata']['uid']==obj['metadata']['uid'] and current['spec']==obj['spec']
        assert current['metadata']['labels']=={'probe':second,'preserve':keep}
        assert exec_text(s,name,'printf %s "$SNAPSHOT"')==first and exec_text(s,name,'cat /meta/probe')==second
        assert any(t.get('method')=='PATCH' for t in s.trace),'must really update label'

    with NodeSession() as s:
        nonce=token('loopback');port=20000+int(token().split('-')[1][:4],16)%20000
        server=container(s,'server',f'mkdir -p /web; printf %s {nonce} > /web/index.html; httpd -f -p {port} -h /web')
        p=s.pod({'containers':[server,container(s,'client')]});name=p['metadata']['name'];ready=s.ready_pod(name)

            code,out,err=s.run(['exec',name,'-c','client','--','wget','-T','2','-qO-',f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/'])

        assert result['other_pod_can_connect'] is False
        assert any(t.get('args',[None])[0]=='exec' and name in t['args'] for t in s.trace)
        assert any(t.get('args',[None])[0]=='exec' and other_name in t['args'] for t in s.trace)

    name=token('deployment');label=token('app')
    spec={'automountServiceAccountToken':False,'terminationGracePeriodSeconds':0,'nodeSelector':{'hw':'compute'},'containers':[container(s,'main')]}
    spec.update(pod_spec)
    spec['nodeSelector']={'hw':'compute',**pod_spec.get('nodeSelector',{})}
    return s.create('deployments',{'apiVersion':'apps/v1','kind':'Deployment','metadata':{'name':name},

        return live if status.get('observedGeneration',0)>=live['metadata']['generation'] and status.get('updatedReplicas',0)==desired and status.get('availableReplicas',0)==desired and status.get('replicas',0)==desired else False

        selector=first['spec']['selector']['matchLabels']['app']

            pods=s.get(s.path('pods')+'?labelSelector=app%3D'+selector)['items']
            return [p for p in pods if any(x.get('restartCount',0)>=1 for x in p.get('status',{}).get('containerStatuses',[]))]
        s.wait(failed_instance,30,'actual failed rollout container restart');s.trace=[]
        result=student()(s.api,s.run,{'name':dep['metadata']['name'],'path':path})
        assert any(t.get('args',[])[:2]==['rollout','undo'] for t in s.trace),'must really request native Deployment rollback'
        restored=ready_deployment(s,dep,30)

        assert restored['metadata']['uid']==first['metadata']['uid'] and restored['spec']['replicas']==1
        assert int(restored['metadata']['annotations']['deployment.kubernetes.io/revision'])>int(first['metadata']['annotations']['deployment.kubernetes.io/revision'])
        sets=s.get(s.path('replicasets',group='/apis/apps/v1'))['items']
